housing: Tempe has a large stock of student apartments near Arizona State University, including buildings leased by the bed, plus ranch houses and condos in the rest of the city.

localRules.text: Every rental home in Maricopa County must be registered with the County Assessor, and the city where it sits enforces this.

climate: Run the air conditioning and photograph the outdoor unit; summer heat makes a broken AC an urgent repair, and monsoon storms can damage roofs and screens.
fact: Leases near ASU often follow the school year, so many Tempe renters move in late July and August.
